reason: The README describes a DSH settings plugin for managing GitHub CLI installation, authentication, Git configuration, and common GitHub repository operations through local gh and git commands.

summaries.zh: 这是一个在 DSH 设置页中集成 GitHub CLI 的插件，用于管理 gh 安装、账户认证、Git 配置及常见仓库操作。
summaries.en: A DSH settings plugin that integrates GitHub CLI to manage gh installation, account authentication, Git configuration, and common repository operations.

capabilities: detects, installs, updates, and locates the GitHub CLI and Git executable
authenticates, switches, logs out, and refreshes GitHub CLI accounts using tokens
reads and writes global Git identity settings
clones, pushes, pulls, forks, creates repositories, creates pull requests, and opens remote repository pages
reads and writes Git proxy configuration and may modify user PATH settings
executes local gh and git subprocesses
